name: Pivot
why: Major cruising refit: 1,320Ah lithium (2022), 2.25kW solar, 5kW Quattro, 70 GPH watermaker, Starlink/Iridium, backup autopilot, newer rig/sails, extensive mechanical work and documented bulkhead reinforcement. Broker supplied a December 2025 condition survey and supporting file stack.
risks: Material structural diligence escalation: seller bulkhead work followed actual movement symptoms; Dec. 2025 survey additionally found excessive corrosion/paint blistering on the forward crossbeam and a large starboard-foredeck crack appearing to compromise structural integrity/waterproofing. Onan has 10,320h; ~3,900–4,100h engines; 51-ft ownership-cost penalty; survey was an insurance/condition survey, not a full pre-purchase haulout/sea-trial survey.
next_step: Ask whether the Dec. 2025 forward-crossbeam corrosion and starboard-foredeck crack were repaired after survey; require invoices/photos and independent pre-purchase survey/haulout before any travel/offer escalation. YOUR DECISION only after repair evidence arrives.
notes: December 2025 survey rated vessel 'average condition' and estimated market value $550k, but it was dockside only with no haulout or trial run. This materially lowers confidence despite the very real refit spend.
